heroSummary: Most Portland Public Schools students start school on Wednesday, August 26, 2026. Students in grades 7–8 at comprehensive middle schools and grades 10–11 at comprehensive high schools start Thursday, August 27. Kindergarten begins Monday, August 31, after Ramp Up sessions August 26–28, and Pre-K/Head Start begins Thursday, September 3. The scheduled last day of school is Tuesday, June 8, 2027.
calendarNotes: Most PPS students begin August 26, but grades 7–8 and 10–11 at comprehensive middle and high schools begin August 27. Kindergarteners attend one assigned half-day during the August 26–28 Ramp Up period before all kindergarten begins August 31. Pre-K and Head Start begin September 3 and have a separate official calendar for program details. Eight early-release Wednesdays apply to schools other than high schools, so families must check the school-level bell schedule. Schools close for day and evening conferences November 23–24 before Fall Break begins November 25. Staff grading and planning days follow the first three quarter endings, producing additional student-free dates in October, January, and April. February 15 and June 9–11 are possible snow make-up dates and remain no-school dates unless PPS uses them.

customSections.label: Early Release, Conference, and Snow Make-Up Dates
customSections.content: Schools other than high schools have early release on September 16, October 21, December 16, January 20, February 17, March 17, April 21, and May 19. Schools close for conferences November 23–24, followed by Fall Break November 25–27. February 15 and June 9–11 are possible snow make-up days; students do not attend unless PPS says those dates are needed.

customSections.label: How PPS Uses Religious and Cultural Observances
customSections.content: These dates are not automatically days off. PPS asks schools to avoid scheduling certain major events on the listed observances, including field trips, back-to-school nights, Outdoor School, assemblies, major tests, PTA and site council meetings, and student performances. Jewish and Muslim observances in the document begin at sundown on the first listed day and end at nightfall on the last.

whatsNew.title: 2026–27 Compared With 2025–26
content: The scheduled last day moves from June 5, 2026, to June 8, 2027.

The 2026–27 calendar includes eight early-release Wednesdays for schools other than high schools. In spring 2026, PPS converted the April 22 and May 13 late-start/early-release dates into full instructional days.
PPS continues to use a staggered opening by grade and program. For 2026–27, kindergarten begins August 31 and Pre-K/Head Start begins September 3.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Portland Public Schools start in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Most students start Wednesday, August 26, 2026. Grades 7–8 and 10–11 at comprehensive middle and high schools start Thursday, August 27.

calendarFaqs.q: When does PPS kindergarten start in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Kindergarten Ramp Up runs August 26–28, with each child attending one assigned half-day session. All kindergarten students begin together Monday, August 31.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Portland Public Schools Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 22, through Friday, March 26, 2027. Students return Monday, March 29.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for PPS in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The scheduled last day is Tuesday, June 8, 2027. June 9–11 are possible snow make-up dates and only become attendance days if PPS uses them.

calendarFaqs.q: Do PPS high schools have early release Wednesdays?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The eight district early-release Wednesdays apply to schools other than high schools. Families should confirm the exact dismissal time on their school's bell schedule.

calendarFaqs.q: Are PPS conference days regular school days?
calendarFaqs.a: No. PPS marks November 23–24 as day and evening conference dates with schools closed to regular classes. Students may attend a scheduled family conference.
